findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant, whereas the prior implementation permitted access only when userTenant matched documentTenant. This introduces a direct cross-tenant authorization bypass.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head fe249ca23170bebf4a3fac08b12fc9adcda43fea, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base version compared userTenant === documentTenant, so the PR continues to bypass tenant ownership checks for every document read.
